description: Load Axiom's documented routing gate at session start, and print Axiom's static statement when a prompt arrives.

hooks.command: printf '%s\n\n' 'You have Axiom. Load this startup front door before deciding whether any Axiom skill applies:'; cat "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/using-axiom/SKILL.md"

printf '%s\n' 'Axiom: material ambiguity that context cannot resolve is clarified before acting; completion rests on evidence observed in this session and names what remains unresolved; replies use the language of the request.'
